answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the forge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
